annotations.title: Add a payment to the Payment Index

description: Adds one payment the caller made to the SwapEazi Payment Index, voluntarily: currencies, amount sent, amount landed (after every deduction), the date it landed and the route type. SwapEazi works out the all-in cost against that day's reference with its landed-cost arithmetic and publishes the row as SELF-REPORTED; with a receipt or statement in files it is read and matched to the figures (amounts within 0.5%, date within 3 days) and published as VERIFIED, and the file is not kept unless keep_file is true. Refused with the reason when a field is invalid, the date is in the future or over two years old, the day has no reference, or the amounts are more than 15% from it. Costs below -50 or above 800 bps, or payments over USD 25m, are held for review, not published. No names, company or account details are taken; the provider is masked (e.g. 'a South African bank') unless show_provider is true. Returns a withdraw token. Same as POST /api/v1/index/payments.

amount_landed.description: What arrived, in the currency received, after every deduction.

amount_sent.description: What left, in the currency sent.

files.description: Optional receipt or statement for VERIFIED: [{ name, media_type, data (base64) }], PDF or image.

keep_file.description: true: keep the file after it is read. Default false: read, matched, not stored.

provider_country.description: Optional two-letter country of the provider, for the masked description.

provider_name.description: Optional; shown on the row only when show_provider is true.

route_type.description: bank, payout_network, otc, exchange, stablecoin, card or not_stated.

show_provider.description: true: show provider_name on the row. Default false (masked).
